item.title: WRE News: Miami Condo Prices Hit Three-Year Low as Market Begins to Stabilize - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - January 11, 2025 - Across South Florida, falling prices, rising inventory and lower mortgage rates are helping stabilize condo sales, with Miami-Dade standing out as a key bellwether, according to WLRN Public Media. item.title: WRE News: Is Social Media Killing the Dance Floor? - World Red Eye
item.description: Miami, FL - January 12, 2025 - In the age of omnipresent cameras, dancing in public has shifted from carefree expression to a calculated risk.
